core_obligations: Compute f^{-1} of a representable sheaf and prove assertion (1) (proof lines 2801-2807).
Rewrite an algebraic space as an etale quotient h_U/h_R (proof lines 2809-2813).
Use exactness of f^{-1} to transport the presentation and conclude by the presentation theorem (proof lines 2813-2815).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for big fppf sites with Sch_{fppf} contained in Sch'_{fppf} and the associated morphisms of topoi, the inverse image functor f^{-1} sends a sheaf representable by a scheme X to the sheaf representable by the same X viewed over S' in the bigger site, and sends algebraic spaces over S to algebraic spaces over S (source lines 2774-2799). The proof computes f^{-1}h_X = h'_X from the description of the inverse image functor, then rewrites an algebraic space as a quotient h_U/h_R of an etale equivalence relation and uses exactness of f^{-1} to get a presentation f^{-1}F = h'_U/h'_R, to which the presentation theorem applies.
